phase: V6 fairness manifest (updated after V1-V4 implementation)

board_set.generator: deterministic private RNG; never reads user saves or game_history
board_set.encoding: cells = exponents 0..15 (0=empty); board = tile values 1<<exp (V5 kernel input)

numpy.note: net slower on 4x4; kept as equivalence/batch reference

numba.note: nopython @njit(cache=True); helpful mainly on evaluate-heavy paths

fixed_conditions.boards: identical fixed set, sha256 verified before each run
fixed_conditions.search_budget: either fixed workload (nodes/simulations/depth) OR fixed wall-clock; never mixed
fixed_conditions.timing_boundary: init/JIT/import separated from measured loop; warm-up separated; gc disabled while measuring
fixed_conditions.numba_jit: separate warm-up; cold compile cost reported separately
fixed_conditions.cpp_extension: separate init; build/import cost reported separately
fixed_conditions.threads: recorded and controlled via OMP/MKL/NUMBA/NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS (currently unset -> library defaults)
fixed_conditions.output: structured JSON + CSV into a timestamped run dir; never overwritten

reporting_rule: Backend Microbenchmark and Solver End-to-End Benchmark are reported separately; never ranked together; equal wall-clock time is NOT equal compute work
